messages:
sophie: FYI customer reported an inbound EUR wire that hit our account but has zero remit info. customer: Acme Health. amount matches invoice but there's no invoice/PO reference in the bank record.

omar: Can you paste the bank statement snippet? is the ordering customer field empty or did the correspondent bank strip it?

sophie: Paste from the bank portal (redacted):
```
Transaction: CREDIT EUR 12,350.00
Value Date: 2026-03-10
Remitter Name: ACME HEALTH
Remittance Info: -
Bank Note: CORRESPONDENT: INTL BK CO - REFERENCE REMOVED
```

li: Looks like a correspondent truncation. We need an MT103 or SWIFT copy from the sending bank to recover the structured :70: field with invoice/PO.

marc: Do we have any matching ledger hits? I searched invoice 2026-1734 and 2026-1735; amounts don't align exactly. Could be VAT differences.

anna-cs: Customer insists they sent invoice #INV-AC-298 and included VAT tag. They provided a payment confirmation PDF but it doesn't show the beneficiary reference.

omar: Ok action items: 1) Ask customer for their bank's MT103/Swift copy. 2) Raise a trace with our correspondent bank to request the original instruction. 3) If no reply, create a temporary allocation hold and tag as "pending trace" in AR.

sophie: I asked Acme to request MT103 from their bank and attach. I also opened a ticket with our bank (case #FB-6128) asking for a trace and to include any stripped :70: text.

li: For the trace, please include these exact asks to the bank:
- Provide MT103 (or SWIFT copy) for transaction reference on value date 2026-03-10
- Include fields :20: (transaction ref), :50K: (ordering customer), :70: (remittance info), and any intermediary bank notes

sophie: Pinged bank support with that text, they replied "Investigation opened, may take 3-5 business days" :hourglass_flowing_sand:. Case ID FB-6128.

marc: Meanwhile I'll mark the incoming cash as unallocated and create a suspense entry. If MT103 arrives and has INV-AC-298 we'll apply; if not we may need a refund/or manual credit once customer confirms.

anna-cs: Customer pushed back — they need proof for their AP team that payment cleared. Can we send a bank payment receipt without remit? That will show amount/date but not invoice mapping.

omar: Yes send a receipt copy but mark "no remittance info found". Also tell AP we requested MT103 — forward their bank's reply once received.

treasury-bot: Auto-note: Case FB-6128 created, investigation ETA 3-5 business days. Please attach any customer-provided MT103 to this thread when available.

li: Quick repro steps for internal docs: 1) Query bank transaction by value date + amount + our account. 2) Check intermediary bank notes for "REFERENCE REMOVED" string. 3) If present, request MT103 from sender bank or request trace via correspondent. 4) On MT103 arrival, parse :70: for invoice/PO. 5) Reconcile and update AR.

sophie: I'll update the customer with the case ID and the expected timeline. tagging @omar and @marc for accounting follow-up. :thumbsup:

omar: Thanks. If the customer can't obtain MT103, escalation path: a) get SWIFT copy from our bank (paid trace), b) legal check for payment confirmation, c) consider manual allocation after signed letter from customer AP.

marc: Noted. I'll prepare a short internal playbook entry and add VAT handling note — if VAT amount mismatch, keep in suspense until matching documentation to avoid tax misreporting.

sophie: Adding final note: customer will try to get MT103 today. I'll post it here when it arrives.

anna-cs: Thx all — I'll keep Acme engaged and escalate internally if no MT103 within 48h.

li: Closing loop: once MT103 arrives, include parsed fields and original bank trace ID in the ticket. If unresolved after 5 business days escalate to finance leadership.
